notes: The breach's dust fitted to the reference (fit_set.py) on frames where it fills the picture's left: how its cloud is thrown, spreads and billows (Breach Cloud: growth, size, speed, drag, direction, wind, thickness, softness, billows, spread), the sky's light on it, its colour and how thick it is; she and her scythe are masked, the worst tenth of the blocks left out (the crows and the shards in front of it); the spread of its colours and its detail weighed in (a fit without them draws one grey mass, the mean of the reference's white billows and their shaded creases).
